role: Prospective acquisition-value test against public-budget-wise efficient fixed-q learning.
rationale: Exact sufficient-statistic calibration; one-time budget tax is reduced without changing confidence delta. A mathematically uniform perfect-information futility test precedes acquisition.
public_fallback: At each public persistence/delay/overhead/budget configuration, exact prior-geometric-risk-optimal single q and optimal spacing; no calibration or evaluation outcomes.
stopping_rule: Keep every original context and fresh seed. Do not change this configuration after outcomes. Any mandatory failure stops confirmation.
scope: Known-mixing stationary Gaussian Markov reward process and a constant-feature critic. Online Lyapunov-optimal gains; q and spacing chosen before learning. No nonlinear MARL or universal no-harm claim.
